schema.description: C2 / D2 — Participating DIDs grouped by role. Each role key MAY be omitted when no participants of that role exist.

did.description: Minimal Did reference. `isTrustExpired` is the [[TG-ACT-3]] visibility flag; per [[TG-QRY-3]] every entity reference MUST carry the visibility flags applicable to its type, and it is always computable as `expiresAtTime` non-null and `< now`.

lastObservedAtTime.description: ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 datetime string in UTC. MUST include the date, the time (with seconds), and the trailing `Z` UTC designator. Fractional seconds are OPTIONAL. Local times, non-UTC offsets, date-only values, and timezone-less times are NOT permitted.
lastObservedAtTime.title: traverse_response_Iso8601DateTime

pattern.description: Architecture pattern per VS-REQ-3 / VS-REQ-4 (A: self-issued; B: delegated); null when the DID presents no ServiceCredential (untrusted DID).
pattern.title: traverse_response_Pattern

corporationId.description: Stable `uint64` id of the DID's owner Corporation per the VPR DID ownership invariant. Never null.

did.title: traverse_response_DidRef

participant.description: Minimal Participant reference. `state` carries the current lifecycle state; non-`ACTIVE` records are retained while referenced per [[TG-ACT-1]] and are returned by traversal with their state. `validatorParticipantId` anchors the `VALIDATED_BY: Participant → Participant` edge (the parent node in the permission tree); it is `null` if and only if `role = ECOSYSTEM` (the chain root, per [[TG-EDGE-4]]).

didId.description: The DID this Participant entry refers to (envelope-derived at ingestion). Identity only; trust state lives on the `Did` node.
didId.title: traverse_response_DidString

anyOf.description: Cosmos bech32 address with the `verana` HRP. Used for the per-Participant `vsOperator` account and for `Corporation.policyAddress`; NOT used as a primary key (Corporation, Ecosystem, CredentialSchema, and Participant primary keys are all `uint64` VPR ledger ids).
anyOf.title: traverse_response_Bech32Address

vsOperator.description: `null` until a VS Operator Authorization has been granted for this entry.

validatorParticipantId.description: Stable VPR id of the validator Participant (parent in the permission tree). `null` iff `role = ECOSYSTEM`; non-negative integer otherwise. The graph persists the value as received from the indexer; the role-conditional rule is enforced upstream at the indexer's ingress.
